exact_tokens: All attention/CtA/search-result/usage-pivot activation surfaces in FinalGUISpec.md, UI_Command_Catalog.md, and Orchestrator_Page.md should route through the canonical route-target model, but currently each surface has its own activation semantics
Create a cross-surface activation contract so all surfaces implement the same canonical route-target model for navigation and object focus
notes: Cross-surface activation contract is needed: attention, CtA, search, usage-pivot, artifact Show-in-* all activate through route_target. Contracts_V0.md should own the canonical shape; FinalGUISpec.md / UI_Command_Catalog.md / Orchestrator_Page.md should reference it.
